item.title: Astellas Stem Cell Eye Therapy
item.description:
• Summary: Astellas Pharma presented early clinical data for a stem cell-derived therapy targeting eye diseases. The investigational treatment, derived from induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs), is designed to restore vision in patients with retinal conditions. Early results suggest potential efficacy and safety.
  • MoAs: Stem cell therapy: iPSC-derived retinal pigment epithelial cells intended to replace damaged cells in the retina, potentially restoring visual function.
  • Sources: Endpoints News
